_comment: Shrink-only baseline for scripts/dependency-tree-check.py (WIC-2132). Every entry needs a human-written `reason`. `classification` is re-verified against the packages on disk on every run; `observedVersion` is informational and is not part of the match key. This file may only shrink: an entry whose row no longer appears is a build failure, so a resolved skew must be deleted here in the same change.
_empty: EMPTY IS THE GOAL STATE, and it is the state as of WIC-2137. Both original entries were resolved, not waived: `@vitest/coverage-v8@1.6.1` by migrating packages/api from vitest 1.6 to vitest 4 (so the only coverage package in the tree is the 4.1.11 one its own vitest asks for), and `esbuild@0.19.12` by declaring esbuild ^0.27.0 at the root, which nests drizzle-kit's correct 0.19.12 under node_modules/drizzle-kit/ instead of hoisting it into the slot both vite copies resolve. `npm ls --all` now exits 0 on its own. Adding an entry here is a real decision: it must be a row that is genuinely benign AND cannot be resolved, with the reason written out at the length of the two WIC-2132 entries (see git history of this file for their form). Prefer fixing the tree.
